# TASK-165 — Essentials level

- **Status:** Done — implemented and verified
- **Area:** Minimal path to a correct specification (2026-10-07)

## Intent

One stored field, one place that follows it. `Spec.level` is `essentials` or `complete` (default `complete`, so every earlier project and the example keep today's bar; migration 008 persists it). `moduleQuestions` is the only place `required` follows the level, so readiness, completeness and the interview change without knowing about it. The 15 essentials are named once in `shared/essentials.ts`; custom questions keep the flag their author gave them. At the essentials level only sections that hold a required question need a review. Nothing is deleted when the level changes. The new-project dialog defaults to Essentials; the API default stays Complete so existing callers do not change.

## What it delivers

`shared/essentials.ts`, `moduleQuestions`, `sectionNeedsReview`, migration 008. Tests: `tests/essentials.test.ts` (12: the 15 exist in both languages, 15 versus 60 required, custom questions, old documents read as complete, readiness, completeness, the interview order, switching), `tests/minimal-spec.test.ts`, `tests/migrations.test.ts`, `new-project.test.tsx`, `readiness.test.tsx`, `e2e/minimal-spec.spec.ts`. `get_project_overview` reports the level to agents. The 15 are one list for every project type (backlog).
